title: elaphoglossum hayesii
intro: Elaphoglossum hayesii, commonly known as the Hawaiian tree fern, is a type of epiphytic fern native to Hawaii. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, which may be attributed to its therapeutic actions such as expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Elaphoglossum hayesii include various compounds like flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand its effects and potential applications in modern medicine.
